escalation.obstacle: Factor two near-verbatim 150-line contradiction theorems in different halves of the tree (ConditionalSpectrum.finite_uniform_precision_contradiction and ConditionalLimits.ambient_uniform_precision_contradiction) into one common core lemma, preserving both statements and the axiom set [propext, Classical.choice, Quot.sound].
escalation.definitions: mu a probability measure on a standard Borel X, p : X -> Y, q : Y -> W (finite version) or q : X -> W (ambient version), b : X -> D with D the Pontryagin dual, g : Y -> Fin m -> D a finite encoding of the conditional kernel: condDistrib b p mu y = (m : ENNReal)^{-1} * sum_i dirac (g y i) a.e. FiniteEncodingApproximationAt mu p q b m gamma: exists r, B, C, H : Fin r -> Y -> Fin m -> C with sum_i ||H i y|| <= C and for every k in K a coefficient family coeff : W -> Fin r -> C, ||coeff w|| <= B, with integral of dist(kernelEncoding (condDistrib b p mu) (fun d => eval (kCoeff k) d) m (p x), sum_i coeff (q (p x)) i * H i (p x))^2 below gamma^2. AmbientEncodingAt is the same with H : Fin r -> X -> Fin m -> C and q : X -> W. Both theorems assume hwild: IsWild of the corresponding differenceLaw, an arc-separation hypothesis with parameters rho, c, N, and conclude False for gamma = ((rho^m/m)/100)/100.
escalation.hypotheses: StandardBorel X, Y, W, nonempty; mu probability; p, q, b measurable; m > 0; rho, c > 0; N > 0; the arc hypothesis for every probability measure on the circle; IsWild difference law.
escalation.attempted_approaches: Read both proofs; they run the same five steps (kernel-encoding distance bound, measurability of the encoding map, mean-zero from the arc hypothesis, phase-collision/averaging, contradiction) with only the domain of H and the space of the wild law changed. Not yet attempted: extracting the used interface, since it needs a compile budget of one module per half (~500 s each) and this block had none.
escalation.expected_useful_output: A Lean file that declares an abstract encoding predicate E with the three or four properties the proofs consume, proves contradiction_from_encoding once (~150 lines), and derives both existing statements as 3-line wrappers; plus the measured line delta and a compile log for the two modified modules.
